name: pokemon-classic-dark
description: A vibrant Pokémon-inspired dark theme for Visual Studio Code.

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const theme=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('themes/pokemon-color-theme.json','utf8')); if (pkg.contributes.themes[0].path !== './themes/pokemon-color-theme.json' || theme.name !== 'Pokémon Classic Dark') process.exit(1); console.log('Theme manifest and theme JSON are valid.');"
